quality_label: Fixed average profile predicted PSNR, weighted by actual delivery count, not decoded-video measurement

tail_definitions.global_p95: per-slot 95th percentile of 30 source AoIs, then averaged
tail_definitions.uav_p95: per-slot 95th percentile of each UAV ten source AoIs, then averaged
tail_definitions.tail_cost: positive excess of source AoI above 4, averaged per native reward

no_delivery_denominator: UAV physical slots; separate from the distribution conditional on delivery
